Important Notice — Lite Garden Capital & The Lite Garden Fund · The fund is temporarily on pause. Invested capital remains protected in the interest of all investors. Undeployed capital is eligible for withdrawal.

Official Statement

Lite Garden Capital &
The Lite Garden Fund

To our valued investors and partners,

It is with deep sincerity and the utmost respect for each of you that we share this important update regarding Lite Garden Capital and The Lite Garden Fund.

Due to personal circumstances, we have made the difficult decision to place the fund in a temporary pause, effective immediately. This was not a decision made lightly, and we want to be fully transparent with every individual who placed their trust in us.

Regarding your capital: All invested capital will continue to be managed with the best interests of our investors as the foremost priority. For those with undeployed capital, full withdrawal options are available and will be processed promptly upon request. Any realized gains will be distributed in a timely manner, and all unrealized gains will remain accessible through the investor portal.

While the future timeline of operations remains uncertain, we remain hopeful that circumstances will allow us to resume at some point. If and when that time comes, we will communicate directly and transparently with each of you.

To every investor and partner who believed in this vision — though our time together was shorter than any of us anticipated, the relationships built and the trust extended to us were not taken for granted. It was a genuine privilege to work alongside each of you, and we are sincerely grateful.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and remain committed to ensuring a smooth and respectful transition for all parties involved.

With respect and gratitude,

Kevan Bartz
Founder, Lite Garden Capital

For withdrawal requests or investor inquiries, please contact us directly.

01 / ABOUT

A builder who thinks differently.

Kevan Bartz is a scrappy entrepreneur, technology enthusiast, inventor, and investor who operates with the clarity of an abstract thinker and the conviction of a futurist. Based in New York City, he has spent more than a decade founding and scaling companies that create tangible value.

He successfully exited Belmont Knight and Associates via acquisition for $25 million, and previously exited Lite Garden Inc. and NextGen Business Services for a combined $14 million — bringing his total exits to $39 million. He recently launched Lite Garden Capital, a private equity platform applying minimalist principles and scrappy execution to high-conviction acquisitions across technology, infrastructure, and growth sectors.

His intellectual property underpins multiple leading sports fantasy and online gambling platforms—quietly powering user experiences for millions while generating significant returns through strategic licensing and partnerships.

Beyond business, Kevan contributes to the scientific community through green energy innovation. His work on wave generation technology and pipeline generators explores new frontiers in sustainable power—turning natural forces and existing infrastructure into clean, efficient energy solutions.

Operating globally • Based in New York City

03 / INNOVATIONS

Green energy.
Real invention.
Future infrastructure.

Wave Generation Technology

Advancing systems that efficiently convert the kinetic energy of ocean and water waves into reliable, clean electricity. Focused on practical deployment, durability in harsh marine environments, and maximizing energy yield for coastal and island communities.

Pipeline Generators

Developing innovative generator technologies integrated with pipeline infrastructure. These systems recover otherwise lost energy from fluid dynamics and pressure differentials, turning existing energy transport networks into distributed power producers.

TECHNOLOGY ENTHUSIAST • INVENTOR
Abstract thinking applied to the physical world.

Every invention starts with questioning assumptions. Kevan brings a futurist lens and minimalist discipline to energy systems—designing for elegance, efficiency, and real-world scalability.
